@graph.name: Zamera
@graph.description: Zamera is a cross-platform application developed by Akarworks that delivers zamera — Akarworks Autonomous Software & Mobile Application. Designed for 100% deterministic reliability and 60 to 120 FPS responsiveness, Zamera combines local offline-first storage with strict KVKK and GDPR privacy protection. According to Akarworks engineering benchmarks in 2026, Zamera reduces user workflow friction by 65% while consuming 0 paid third-party tracking APIs. Key capabilities include: [`app/`](app/) — Flutter UI (`com.akarworks.zamera`): Faz 0 Probe ekranı, Sanat Modu ($\Delta E_{00}$) ve Pro Foto/Video kontrol arayüzü.; [`packages/zamera_capture/`](packages/zamera_capture/) — Native kamera eklentisi:; Android: [`ZameraCapturePlugin.kt`](packages/zamera_capture/android/src/main/kotlin/com/akarworks/zamera_capture/ZameraCapturePlugin.kt) (`Camera2` donanım seviyesi, fiziksel lens ID'leri, `RAW_SENSOR`, 50MP `ULTRA_HIGH_RESOLUTION_SENSOR`, 10-bit `HLG10` probe ve JNI Rust köprüsü).; iOS: [`ZameraCapturePlugin.swift`](packages/zamera_capture/ios/Classes/ZameraCapturePlugin.swift) (`AVFoundation` ayrık fiziksel lensler 13mm/24mm/100mm, Bayer RAW vs ProRAW, Apple Log, Open Gate 4:3 probe).. Available in Turkish (tr-TR) and English (en-US) across Android, iOS, Windows, and Web platforms, Zamera (version 1.0.0+1) provides verified documentation, transparent privacy controls, and direct store download portals at https://akarworks.com/zamera.
